captions.text: Your mission: fly to Mars and build an outpost
Earth and Mars both circle the Sun. Mars is farther out and slower
Launch when Mars is about 44 degrees ahead of Earth
The ship coasts on a curved path around the Sun...
...and meets Mars about 259 days (8.5 months) later
Earth and Mars line up for launches only every 26 months
Build a working outpost before the next ships arrive
